'''The Caves of Batuu / Finders Keepers''' is the twenty-third episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney Junior]] on [[March 1]], [[2024]].<ref name="Disney March" />
